title: Evaluation of nitrotyrosine expression on the surface of CD8+ T cells
protocol: Culture splenocytes from OT-1 mice at 37°C in a 95% air/5% CO₂ environment saturated with H₂O, containing SIINFEKL peptide at 10 μg/ml and MDSCs at a 3:1 ratio.
Incubate the cells for 5 hours, 24 hours, or 48 hours in complete media on a poly-d-lysine coated glass bottom culture dish.

Label the cells with 6 μl of antibodies against Gr-1 (conjugated with PE), CD8 (conjugated with Alexa 647), Nitrotyrosine (conjugated with Alexa 488), or isotype IgG conjugated with Alexa 488 and incubate on ice for 40-60 minutes.
Wash the cells twice with PBS + 2% FBS.
Add complete media to the dishes, keeping them on ice.
View the cells using a DMI6000 inverted Leica TCS AOBS SP5 tandem scanning confocal microscope equipped with a 40x /1.30NA oil immersion objective.
Apply tunable 488 Argon and 546 and 633 laser lines to excite the samples using AOBS line switching to minimize crosstalk between fluorochromes.
Produce images and Z-stacks with three cooled photomultiplier detectors using LAS AF version 1.5.1.889 software suite.
